purpose: Create, validate, and publish complete multi-cell cliff recipes without editing third-party source sheets in place.

canvasModel.leftPanel: read-only source atlas on the exact 32x32 game grid; Ctrl+click selects multiple source cells or drag-selects a rectangular source region
canvasModel.rightPanel: Havenwild-owned assembly canvas on the same world-cell scale; selected source regions load here for non-destructive recipe authoring

recipeWorkflow: Open the source sheet through the semantic Asset Palette in read-only mode.
Use the 32x32 grid only to address cells; select the complete authored multi-cell source region needed by the feature.
Load the selected region into the separate Havenwild working/assembly canvas without modifying the source layer.
Record sourceGridSpan and sourceRectPx independently from worldVisualFootprintTiles.
Author structuralHostMask, collisionEdgeMask, traversalEdgeMask, anchor, draw order, and occlusion independently from the visual source envelope.
Assign a role such as face repeat, corner, side face, cave host, ladder, ramp, bridge socket, water-facing face, or waterfall host only after the complete visual assembly is inspected.
Preview the recipe against discrete Level 0-2 platform boundaries and large canonical formations, never against smooth painted height.
Publish atlas/recipe metadata, thumbnail, acceptance fixture, runtime binding, source hash, license, and credits atomically.
topologyCertificationWorkflow: Show source-grid span and world visual footprint as separate overlays.
For multi-cell features, selection publishes only after the complete visual envelope is outlined.
Structural-host, collision and traversal overlays remain separate authoring channels and may stay pending while visual geometry is certified.
Display a red Runtime Quarantined badge until every required acceptance-scene case is complete.
